title: Deer Kaomoji ╰૮₍ •\./• ₎ა╯: Copy & Paste Deer Faces
meta_description: Copy deer kaomoji and reindeer text faces: antlered ╰૮₍ •\./• ₎ა╯ deer, Ψ(•ᴥ•)Ψ stags, a red-nosed Ψ(•●•)Ψ reindeer for Christmas, and gentle fawns.
hero_tagline: Deer, fawns and reindeer drawn in text, antlers included. Tap any deer to copy it.
intro: Antlers turn a text face into a deer. In ╰૮₍ •\./• ₎ა╯ the box-drawing curves ╰ and ╯ sweep up on each side like branching antlers, ૮ and ა are the ears, and \./ is the long, narrow nose that ends in a dark tip. A simpler stag uses Ψ, the Greek letter psi, whose three prongs look like a single antler. Leave the antlers off and the same face becomes a fawn. Put a ● where the nose goes and you have a red-nosed reindeer for Christmas messages. Text deer are rarer than cats or bears, so this set is smaller, and the ૮ ა ears are Gujarati and Georgian letters that a few older devices show as boxes. The 🦌 deer emoji is on the animal emoji page.

sections.label: Fawns
sections.intro: No antlers yet: the ૮ ა ears and the \./ nose are enough to read as a young deer.

sections.label: Stags & Reindeer
sections.intro: Ψ makes a three-pointed antler on each side. A ● nose turns the stag into a red-nosed reindeer.

faq.a: ╰ and ╯ are box-drawing characters (U+2570 and U+256F). Their curves rise from the bottom corners of the face and look like a pair of antlers spreading outward.

faq.q: How do you make a reindeer in text?
faq.a: Use Ψ for antlers on both sides and a solid ● for a shiny red nose, as in Ψ(•●•)Ψ. Add ❄ or ★ for a Christmas message.

faq.q: Why are there fewer deer kaomoji than cat ones?
faq.a: Deer have no single character that obviously reads as their face, the way ᴥ suggests a bear or ω a cat. Most deer faces are recent builds that borrow ears from other kaomoji and add antlers around them.
